referenceCadence.note: Cadence is derived from the original nailgun/haste formula. No shoot(), bullet collision, magazine, upgraded-damage or reload claim; each direct .1 hit isolates hit-stop without killing normal-HP bosses.

recipe.fixture: Original 2400x1800 world dimensions; ordinary enemies isolated and spawnClock=1e9; solid obstacles/decor removed and Navigation rebuilt. Player/boss positions use Game.move with blocked checks. skillCd=0 is an explicit immediate-pattern probe. No HP/maxHP increase, no added invulnerability, no normal movement-speed/damage/attack-duration override.
